items.name: 03-ai-research
items.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity desktop SaaS UI concept for a Chinese internal ecommerce product research workbench called 选品工作台. Flat front-on digital UI screenshot, no device mockup, no 3D, no perspective. Professional IBM Carbon meets Linear style, quiet dense enterprise data UI. Restrained low saturation palette: offwhite #F7F8FA canvas, white panels, nearblack #17191D text, secondary #737984, hairline #E4E7EC borders, muted steel blue #536B86 accent. Small corner radii 4-6px, precise 8px grid, restrained shadows, slim icons, no gradients, no saturated rainbow badges, no giant marketing stats. Simplified Chinese typography excellent and clear; tabular numbers. Persistent 208px charcoal sidebar, light main canvas. Sidebar: 发现商品, AI研究台, 候选与观察池, 任务中心, 数据与模型设置; bottom avatar 运营管理员. Header 美国站 and global search. Full desktop 16:10 composition at high resolution, legible thoughtful spacing. Small top-right label 界面概念 · 示例状态. Do not imply any running system exists. No invented live API results. Show AI研究台 selected. This is a complete research task composition screen, not a chatbot. Top title 新建选品研究, subtitle 从商品事实到可追溯建议. Left main pane natural language brief field containing 寻找美国站适合差异化开发的家居照明产品，关注需求稳定性、同质化和价格空间. Below: selected source scope Temu / SHEIN, region US, category 家居照明, research modes 标准品复核 / 差异化机会, 3 selected product cards, one vine light thumbnail. Show evidence coverage strips 已有商品数据 / 趋势需核验 / 亚马逊待配置. Right side compact run configuration with 数据调用预算 and AI费用上限 input fields blank with placeholder 请输入预算, research model GPT 6.1 Terra, routing model Decisions API, button 预览研究计划. Bottom main pane expandable proposed steps 获取数据 → 检查缺失 → 比较候选 → 整理证据, each 待执行. Disabled final button 创建并运行 and explanatory 先设置预算. Small evidence report preview section with three columns 事实 / 推断 / 待确认, clearly preview placeholders, not completed analysis. Calm useful tool with no glowing AI magic.
